skill.name: sales-funnel-blueprint
skill.description: Turn an offer into a concrete multi-step sales funnel spec - page-by-page structure, price ladder, copy outline and the metrics each step must hit. Use when asked to build a sales funnel, marketing funnel, landing page flow, lead magnet funnel, webinar funnel, tripwire or VSL funnel, when planning a product launch page flow, or when someone asks "what pages do I need" for selling something online.
skill.summary: Create a build-ready sales funnel plan with pages, pricing, copy direction, metrics, instrumentation, and implementation order.
skill.author: autonnel

security_audit.summary: All 19 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, benign links, marketing terminology, or localhost documentation. A separate medium-risk issue remains because the instructions launch repository-defined containers without requiring an immutable revision or image digest.

remediation.issue: The setup guidance runs Docker Compose content from an external repository without requiring immutable source and image verification.
remediation.suggestion: Require a reviewed commit SHA, pin container images by digest, inspect the Compose file, and obtain confirmation before launching containers.

content.user_title: Build a Measurable Sales Funnel Blueprint
content.value_statement: Unclear funnel structure creates disconnected pages, weak offers, and missing measurement. This skill turns offer details into a practical page, pricing, and tracking plan.
actual_capabilities: Selects a standard funnel shape from offer price, traffic source, audience awareness, fulfilment, and existing assets.
Defines each page's goal, message structure, proof, objections, fields, price framing, exit path, and target metric.
Builds an entry offer, immediate upsell, downsell, and back-end price ladder.
Lists required conversion events, attribution identifiers, revenue data, and an initial testing slot.
Orders implementation work and records assumptions that require user confirmation.
limitations: Produces a specification but does not build pages, write complete copy, or configure payment systems.
Uses general benchmark ranges that must be replaced with account-specific performance data.
Requires offer, price, traffic, awareness, and fulfilment details for a reliable recommendation.
Does not replace legal, privacy, tax, accessibility, or advertising compliance review.

use_cases.title: Plan a First Product Funnel
use_cases.description: Turn a defined offer and acquisition channel into a page sequence, price ladder, measurement plan, and build order.
use_cases.target_user: Independent creators launching a digital product

use_cases.title: Structure an Ecommerce Campaign
use_cases.description: Map an advertisement through product landing, checkout, post-purchase upsell, and order confirmation with measurable targets.

use_cases.title: Design a Service Application Flow
use_cases.description: Plan qualification, booking, and confirmation steps for a higher-priced service that requires a sales conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Funnel Shape
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a funnel shape for [offer] priced at [price], promoted through [traffic source] to [audience]. Explain the choice and list assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Page Blueprint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a page-by-page funnel blueprint for [offer]. Include each page goal, traffic context, message sections, proof, objections, fields, pricing, exit path, and metric.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Price and Measurement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an entry offer, upsell, downsell, and back end for [offer]. Add conversion events, attribution fields, revenue data, benchmarks, and one test.
prompt_templates.scenario: Growth team planning monetization and analytics

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose and Redesign a Funnel
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this funnel and its metrics: [details]. Identify structural problems before page changes. Produce a revised flow, targets, build order, and unresolved assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operator restructuring an existing funnel

output_examples.input: Plan a funnel for a $39 meal-planning course promoted through cold social advertisements.
output: Chosen shape: direct offer with checkout, one-click upsell, and thank-you page.
Landing target: send 5-15% of visitors to checkout as an initial benchmark.
Price ladder: $39 course, complementary recipe pack upsell, and smaller template downsell.
Launch blockers: purchase event, click identifier, revenue value, currency, and one headline test.

output_examples.input: Create a funnel for a $2,000 consulting package targeting search visitors.
output: Chosen shape: qualification form followed by booking and confirmation.
The landing page explains outcomes, evidence, fit criteria, and the application call to action.
The form collects only qualification details required for routing and sales preparation.
Open assumptions include sales capacity, qualification thresholds, proof assets, and follow-up ownership.

best_practices: Provide the offer, price, traffic source, audience awareness, fulfilment method, and existing assets before requesting a blueprint.
Treat benchmark ranges as starting points and replace them with observed account data.
Confirm tracking requirements and privacy obligations before implementation begins.
anti_patterns: Do not force a sales funnel onto a brochure site or simple contact form.
Do not send expensive cold offers directly to checkout without testing qualification or trust-building steps.
Do not launch pages before purchase, revenue, attribution, and step-level conversion events are verified.

faq.question: Does this skill build the funnel?
faq.answer: No. It creates a build-ready specification for a human, agent, or page-building platform.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the offer, price, traffic source, audience awareness, fulfilment method, existing assets, and current performance data.

faq.question: Can it plan lead generation funnels?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define opt-in, delivery, nurture, offer, application, booking, and confirmation steps.

faq.question: Are the conversion targets guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. They are general starting benchmarks and must be compared with your account, channel, audience, and offer data.

faq.question: Does it support ecommerce and services?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers store flows, digital products, physical products, applications, bookings, webinars, and long-form sales paths.

faq.question: Can I use any funnel platform?
faq.answer: Yes. The specification is platform-neutral, although implementation details depend on your builder, payment system, analytics tools, and hosting environment.
